title: Needle trajectory
view: Midline sagittal section of the lumbar spine at L3-L4: the back's skin at the top, the head to the right, the vertebral bodies at the bottom.
teachingPoint: Stay midline and angle slightly toward the head: through the supraspinous and interspinous ligaments, the ligamentum flavum and the dura into the CSF, between the spinous processes and through the interlaminar window.
claims: Midline sagittal section, head to the right (the landmark plate's way round).
Needle angled about 12 degrees cephalad from the perpendicular (record: slightly cephalad).
Layers in order: skin, subcutaneous fat, supraspinous ligament, interspinous ligament, ligamentum flavum, epidural fat, dura, CSF (record).
Introducer to about 2.6 cm, then the pencil-point spinal needle through it, tip in the CSF (record: introducer, atraumatic needle).
Standard anatomy added: spinous processes 3.8 cm apart, the dura about 5 cm deep, a 1.4 cm thecal sac with cauda equina roots, the L3-L4 disc and vertebral bodies.
Labels: Supraspinous ligament, Interspinous ligament, Ligamentum flavum, Dura, CSF.
